verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs for frontend and backend: Rollbar.js covers both server-side and client-side JavaScript (React, Angular, Express, Next.js), and the evidence also shows a Ruby gem, a .NET SDK and a Magento2 module that automatically reports all PHP errors and exceptions. Mobile support is only implied by an Apple Unified Logging module for RollbarNotifier, and automatic uncaught-error capture is explicit only for Magento2. Missing for 10: explicit official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android/React Native), documented automatic uncaught-exception capture across the JS and backend SDKs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my web frontend, backend services, and mobile apps with official SDKs that capture uncaught errors automatically

citations.quote: Rollbar.js supports both server-side and client-side Javascript, including frameworks such as React, Angular, Express, Next.js and more.
The module should automatically report all PHP errors and exceptions in your Magento2 app.
This module implements RollbarNotifier integration with Apple Unified Logging (AUL) and allows capture of the AUL entries as corresponding Rollbar Telemetry log events.
Rollbar supports over a dozen platforms, and our community has built many more.
